associates.clause: An Officer must take all reasonable steps to ensure that their Associated Parties do not deal in Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities without the Officer obtaining approval under this policy.
associates.reasoning: Associated Party is defined in Annexure B to include an Officer's immediate family, spouse and any company, trust or superannuation fund they control, and Officers must ensure those associates do not deal without first obtaining approval, though this extension applies only to the Officer tier, not general employees.

tiers.tier_name: Directors and employees of the Wesfarmers Group

findings.question: cash_hedge
findings.clause: All directors and employees of the Wesfarmers Group are prohibited from: (a) dealing in any securities where the person dealing in the securities has inside information in relation to those securities; (b) passing on inside information to others who may deal in securities; and (c) applying to participate in a Wesfarmers share plan while in possession of inside information.
findings.reasoning: General directors and employees are bound only by the prohibition on dealing while in possession of inside information; the hedging clearance requirement in Annexure B paragraph 9(e) applies only to Officers (directors and Leadership Team members), so no clause permits or restricts hedging for the wider workforce.

findings.question: physical_hedge
findings.clause: All directors and employees of the Wesfarmers Group are prohibited from: (a) dealing in any securities where the person dealing in the securities has inside information in relation to those securities; (b) passing on inside information to others who may deal in securities; and (c) applying to participate in a Wesfarmers share plan while in possession of inside information.
findings.reasoning: As with a cash-settled hedge, the Annexure B hedging clearance requirement is limited to Officers; general employees are subject only to the inside information prohibition.

findings.question: encumber

findings.reasoning: The Annexure B paragraph 9(d) restriction on creating a security interest applies only to Officers and their Associated Parties; general employees have no clause addressing encumbering their vested shares.

findings.reasoning: The margin loan clearance requirement in Annexure B paragraph 9(d) is limited to Officers; general employees are left with only the inside information prohibition.

findings.question: borrow_against_derivative

findings.reasoning: As with a loan secured directly on the shares, the Annexure B financing restriction reaches only Officers; general employees have no applicable clause.

findings.question: stock_loan

findings.reasoning: No clause addresses lending securities under a title-transfer arrangement for general directors and employees, whose only constraint is the inside information prohibition.

findings.question: lender_enforcement
findings.clause: All directors and employees of the Wesfarmers Group are prohibited from: (a) dealing in any securities where the person dealing in the securities has inside information in relation to those securities; (b) passing on inside information to others who may deal in securities; and (c) applying to participate in a Wesfarmers share plan while in possession of inside information.
findings.reasoning: Blackout Periods and the Annexure B exceptional-circumstances clearance process apply only to Officers and their Associated Parties; general employees are not subject to any blackout period, so a lender's enforcement sale is unaddressed and their only constraint is the inside information prohibition.

tiers.tier_name: Officer (directors and members of the Wesfarmers Leadership Team)

findings.question: cash_hedge
findings.clause: hedging Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities, unless approval has been sought and clearance obtained from the Wesfarmers Company Secretary, and all steps outlined in paragraph 3 of this Annexure B have been complied with.
findings.reasoning: Officers (directors and Leadership Team members) may hedge Wesfarmers securities only with approval and clearance from the Company Secretary and by following the paragraph 3 process; the separate Corporations Act restriction in this Annexure only reaches remuneration still subject to disposal restrictions, so it does not affect fully vested, unrestricted shares.

findings.question: physical_hedge
findings.clause: hedging Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities, unless approval has been sought and clearance obtained from the Wesfarmers Company Secretary, and all steps outlined in paragraph 3 of this Annexure B have been complied with.
findings.reasoning: The hedging clearance requirement is settlement-method neutral and so applies equally to a physically settled collar or put over vested, unrestricted shares.

findings.question: encumber
findings.clause: creating a security interest or other financial interest, or entering into a margin loan in respect of, Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities; and (e) hedging Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities, unless approval has been sought and clearance obtained from the Wesfarmers Company Secretary, and all steps outlined in paragraph 3 of this Annexure B have been complied with.
findings.reasoning: Creating a security interest over the shares is expressly listed among the dealings an Officer may only undertake with the Company Secretary's approval and clearance.

findings.question: borrow_against_stock
findings.clause: creating a security interest or other financial interest, or entering into a margin loan in respect of, Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities; and (e) hedging Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities, unless approval has been sought and clearance obtained from the Wesfarmers Company Secretary, and all steps outlined in paragraph 3 of this Annexure B have been complied with.
findings.reasoning: Entering into a margin loan in respect of Wesfarmers securities is expressly named as requiring the Company Secretary's approval and clearance before an Officer may proceed.

findings.question: borrow_against_derivative
findings.clause: creating a security interest or other financial interest, or entering into a margin loan in respect of, Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities; and (e) hedging Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities, unless approval has been sought and clearance obtained from the Wesfarmers Company Secretary, and all steps outlined in paragraph 3 of this Annexure B have been complied with.
findings.definition: securities includes shares, options, notes, bonds and other debentures, interests in managed investment schemes, trusts and other financial products, and any derivatives of those securities, including equity swaps, contracts for difference, futures, hedges and exchange-traded or over-the-counter options, whether settled by cash or otherwise.
findings.reasoning: Paragraph 9(d) reaches a margin loan 'in respect of' Wesfarmers securities rather than only a loan secured directly by the shares, and the Policy's broad definition of securities (including derivatives such as collars and puts) supports reading this as financing in respect of securities generally, so a loan secured on a derivative also needs the same Company Secretary approval and clearance.

findings.question: stock_loan
findings.clause: Without limiting the other provisions of this policy, an Officer must complete the following steps if they, or their Associated Parties, wish to deal in Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities, including a dealing of the type described in paragraph 9:
findings.definition: transferring legal ownership of securities, even where beneficial ownership does not change;
findings.reasoning: A title-transfer securities loan transfers legal ownership of the shares, which the definition of dealing sweeps in; Officers must notify the Company Secretary and await written clearance before undertaking any dealing, including one not listed in paragraph 9.

findings.question: lender_enforcement
findings.clause: the Officer has identified another exceptional circumstance where the dealing by an Officer or their Associated Parties of their Wesfarmers securities is the only reasonable option available to resolve the circumstance; or
findings.definition: selling or otherwise disposing of securities, whether on-market or off-market;
findings.reasoning: A forced sale by a secured lender is a disposal of securities and so a 'dealing' during a Blackout Period; the Policy has no automatic exclusion for it, but the Chairman may approve it under the exceptional-circumstances limb of the Blackout Period exception process.
